title: Characterize admitted real-SWAP corrector head path from existing F-GC45 live coupling

source_failure.symptom: First fixed-head corrector probe at H_ref-1e-5 m returned GW_SWAP_PARTICIPANT_TRIAL_FAILED (status 6).

method: Run the unchanged existing F-GC45 real MultiSWAP + MODFLOW6 end-to-end test on the same bridge and pinned MODFLOW6 6.8.0 build. Record every head for which its real SWAP corrector returns an accepted trial.
outputs: per-iteration corrector q1, q2, weighted q
final accepted head and ledger exchange
gate: The existing F-GC45 end-to-end test must pass unchanged.
interpretation: This diagnostic defines an empirically admitted corrector-head path. It does not validate MAP01 fixed-head offsets and does not change MAP01's failed status.
forbidden: do not infer a derivative from the live iteration path itself
